segments.text: THis commaunde I you, that ye loue together. If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you. If ye were of the worlde, the world would loue his owne: howbeit, becauſe ye are not of the worlde, but I haue choſen you out of the worlde, therfore the worlde hateth you. Remembre the worde that I ſayed vnto you: the ſeruaunt is not greater then the lorde. If they haue perſecuted me, they wil alſo perſecute you. If they haue kepte my ſaying, they will kepe yours alſo. But all theſe thinges will they doe vnto you for my names ſake, becauſe they haue not knowen him that ſente me. If I had not come and ſpoken vnto them, they ſhoulde haue had no ſynne: but nowe haue they nothing to cloke theyr ſynne with all. He that hateth me, hateth my father alſo. If I had not done among them the workes whiche none other man did, they ſhould haue had no ſynne. But nowe haue they both ſeen and hated: not onely me, but alſo my father. But this happeneth that the ſaying might be fulfilled that is written in theyr lawe. They hated me without a cauſe. But when the comforter is come, whom I will ſende vnto you from the father, euen the ſpirite of trueth (whiche procedeth of the father) he ſhal teſtifie of me. And ye ſhall beare witnes alſo, becauſe ye haue been with me from the beginning.
